newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: World copra and palm kernels output seen up in '97.
newsitem.headline: World copra and palm kernels output seen up in '97.

text.p: World copra and palm kernels production is expected to rise to 10.3 million tonnes in 1997, said Thomas Mielke, editor of Oil World.
"This is a record high and up 0.8 million tonnes from last year's relatively low level," Mielke told a palm/laurics oil conference on Saturday.
He said the rise was mainly due to a recovery in Philippine copra production by almost 0.5 million tonnes owing to improved yields resulting from more favourable precipitation.

A sizeable increase in Indonesian production by 0.2 million tonnes in palm kernels and 0.1 million tonnes in copra because of rising mature area under palm and coconut trees is also seen boosting the world's output, he said.
